rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.short_description: A cozy and elegant room designed for comfort, featuring modern amenities and a serene atmosphere.
rooms.description: Crafted for discerning solo pilgrims and couples, the Deluxe Room harmoniously blends timeless Indian warmth with contemporary minimalist elegance. Enjoy custom king bedding dressed in 400-thread-count Egyptian cotton, acoustic double-glazed soundproofing for tranquil meditation, and custom ambient lighting designed for restful recovery after sacred darshan tours.

rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.short_description: Spacious sanctuary with bespoke timber accents, courtyard view, and an oversized rain bath.
rooms.description: The Superior Room elevates your spiritual retreat with enhanced square footage, an inviting seating lounge by panoramic windows, and views overlooking the peaceful inner courtyard garden. Features artisanal brass fixtures, hand-loomed rugs, and a marble bath that creates a personal sanctuary.

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.short_description: Expansive family residence with dual bedrooms, plush dining nook, and generous living area.
rooms.description: Ideal for multigenerational families visiting Braj Bhumi together, the Family Suite provides dual queen beds, two private dressing vanity nooks, and a serene common sitting room. The suite is outfitted with child and elder safety considerations, complimentary puja preparation kits, and express room dining services.

rooms.name: Premium Suite
rooms.short_description: The pinnacle of luxury at Kanha Residency. Private balcony, bespoke lounge, and private butler service.
rooms.description: Our flagship accommodation offers peerless luxury in Mathura. The Premium Suite features an expansive private balcony overlooking peaceful Mathura sunrises, an opulent living salon with hand-carved jali panels, a deep soaking tub with panoramic vistas, and dedicated concierge access for personalized private temple journeys.

reviews.title: An oasis of peace in Mathura
reviews.review: Kanha Residency was the highlight of our Mathura & Vrindavan pilgrimage. The tranquil aesthetics, impeccably clean linen, warm courteous staff, and pure sattvic culinary offerings made our stay unforgettable. The concierge arranged our early morning VIP darshan with effortless grace.

reviews.title: Perfect for family and elderly parents
reviews.review: Traveled with my 72-year-old parents. The lift access, comfortable bedding, and quiet ambience after long temple walks was exactly what we prayed for. Highly recommended for families seeking peace and luxury.

reviews.title: World-class hospitality rooted in Braj tradition
reviews.review: Subtle incense, warm tea upon arrival, and breathtaking architectural details. Kanha Residency sets a new standard for hospitality in Uttar Pradesh.

enquiries.name: Meera Kapur
enquiries.message: Namaste, we are planning a 4-day Vrindavan & Mathura parikrama tour for 8 elders in May. Do you provide temple transfers and satvik breakfast?
